subject: MAP + Eval Plan: success signals, exit gates, acceptance tests for pilot
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Kara Mitchell <kara@mediwell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 May 2023 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff & proposed acceptance tests

Hi Kara —

Thanks again for the time today. Attached is a starter MAP and an outline of acceptance tests we propose for the 4-week pilot. High level intent: make the evaluation objective and finishable (clear pass/fail checks) so your team can sign off or request remediation without ambiguity.

Quick highlights in the sheet:
- Success signals (accuracy thresholds, latency percentiles, error tolerances)
- Exit gates (data quality, security checklist, consumer-facing error rate)
- Acceptance tests (sample prompts, integration smoke tests, throttling/scale scenarios)

Ask: can you confirm the stakeholder list on the first tab and whether the initial 2 use-cases (triage routing + note summarization) are the right focus? If so we’ll lock the tests and schedule the instrumented runs.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Kara Mitchell <kara@mediwell.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@mediwell.com>
Date: Fri, 26 May 2023 12:01:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & proposed acceptance tests

Thanks Sofia — this looks useful. Two quick notes:
1) Stakeholders: replace the clinical lead with Dr. Patel (she'll be on the executive signoff lane).
2) Use-cases: prioritize note summarization first; triage routing can be second.

On acceptance tests, our bar for summarization is: mean ROUGE-L >= 0.55 on the supplied holdout and for latency P95 < 800ms. Are those negotiable?

If you can update the MAP with Dr. Patel and the tuned thresholds, we'll try to lock sign-off by end of next week.

—Kara
Kara Mitchell
VP Product, MediWell
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 May 2023 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: internal: adjust thresholds & instrumentation plan

Sofia / Marissa —

Saw Kara's reply. Quick proposals to keep the MAP tight and testable:
- Set initial ROUGE-L target at 0.52 (we can aim for 0.55 but leave a remediation path to 0.52 + quality review)
- P95 target of 700ms on our dedicated instance for the pilot (gives margin)
- Add a synthetic load test to the acceptance doc to prove P95 holds under 20 RPS

I'll draft the updated MAP and attach the test harness instructions. If we commit to 700ms and 0.52 ROUGE-L, we should be able to present a clean pass/fail to MediWell's execs.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Kara Mitchell <kara@mediwell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2023 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & proposed acceptance tests

Kara —

Attaching the updated MAP and acceptance-tests doc (files listed at top). Key changes per Ben:
- Summarization ROUGE-L: target 0.52 (remediation pathway to 0.55 documented)
- Latency (P95): 700ms target on our pilot config; stress test at 20 RPS included
- Evidence required for signoff: 100 annotated holdout examples + perf logs + access to error trace for two failure cases

Planned timeline:
- This week: finalize MAP and instrument the test harness (our side)
- Week 1 of pilot: run smoke and sample validation with your holdout (you get interim data)
- Week 3: full conformance run and exec review (decision gate)

Can you confirm Dr. Patel as the signoff exec and whether end-of-week for a MAP lock works?

Best,
Sofia
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@mediwell.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Kara Mitchell <kara@mediwell.com>

We'll plan the final exec review for Friday week 3 (tentative).
